subject: Re: Kickoff: Light Field Neural Rendering productization
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing:

- Katya Silva 60% tech lead; Ondrej Bergstrom 40% on quality evals; Emeka Pinto 30% and Chiara Olsen 30% on infra + dataset plumbing.
- The repo pins jax[cuda110]==0.2.19, which fights our cluster CUDA image — Emeka is validating the version bump this week before we burn real GPU hours.

Good news on money: Idris Osei has verbally earmarked the $180k in Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-36 for this project, so the H100 hours for the full shiny-dataset training grid are covered without touching the portfolio baseline. I'll get it in writing when the Q3 books open, but I'm planning against it now.

Ask: dataset mirroring from the external NeX drives to our storage needs ~2TB; Chiara files the ticket today.

Santiago
